token.label: API Key
token.description: You can obtain API key from [API Settings](https://doctly.ai/keys).

doctly_list_documents.label: List Documents
doctly_list_documents.description: Lists processed documents, newest first, with optional filters.

search.label: Search
search.description: Text to match in the file name.

extractorId.label: Extractor ID
extractorId.description: Only documents run through this extractor (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.

noExtractor.label: No Extractor
noExtractor.description: Set to true for plain markdown conversions only. Defaults to false.

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: Only documents uploaded by this user (UUID).

userEmail.label: User Email
userEmail.description: Only documents uploaded by the user with this email.

dateFrom.label: Date From
dateFrom.description: Only documents created on or after this date, e.g. 2026-01-31.

dateTo.label: Date To
dateTo.description: Only documents created on or before this date, e.g. 2026-01-31.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max documents to return (1-100). Defaults to 50.

skip.label: Skip
skip.description: How many documents to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0.

doctly_delete_document.label: Delete Document
doctly_delete_document.description: Permanently deletes a document and its files.

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: Document ID (UUID). Returned by Convert Document, Run Extractor and List Documents.

doctly_list_extractors.label: List Extractors
doctly_list_extractors.description: Lists the extractors available in the account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max extractors to return (1-100). Defaults to 50.

skip.label: Skip
skip.description: How many extractors to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0.

extractorId.label: Extractor ID
extractorId.description: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.

doctly_update_extractor.label: Update Extractor
doctly_update_extractor.description: Updates an extractor's name, slug or description.

extractorId.label: Extractor ID
extractorId.description: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.

doctly_remix_extractor.label: Remix Extractor
doctly_remix_extractor.description: Creates an editable copy of an extractor.

extractorId.label: Extractor ID
extractorId.description: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.

doctly_get_extractor_upgrade_info.label: Get Extractor Upgrade Info
doctly_get_extractor_upgrade_info.description: Checks whether a newer version of an extractor is available.

extractorId.label: Extractor ID
extractorId.description: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.

doctly_upgrade_extractor.label: Upgrade Extractor
doctly_upgrade_extractor.description: Upgrades an extractor to its latest version.

extractorId.label: Extractor ID
extractorId.description: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.

doctly_delete_extractor.label: Delete Extractor
doctly_delete_extractor.description: Deletes an extractor from the account.

extractorId.label: Extractor ID
extractorId.description: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.

doctly_get_usage.label: Get Usage
doctly_get_usage.description: Gets credit balance and monthly usage.

months.label: Months
months.description: How many calendar months to include, counting the current one (1-36). Defaults to 12.
